name: Tagged Singletons
definition: Following \cite{maass1992lower}, for $n\geq2$ put $r=\lceil\log_2 n\rceil$ and let $f(i)$ be the least $\ell\in[r]$ with $i\leq\sum_{j=1}^{\ell}n2^{-j}+r+1$. On domain $[n+r]$, the tagged-singleton class is $$\{\emptyset\}\cup\{\{n+\ell\}:\ell\in[r]\}\cup\{\{i,n+f(i)\}:i\in[n]\}.$$ Thus each singleton on $[n]$ receives one binary-address tag, while the tag coordinates themselves also occur as singletons.
